description: Spacefast is a publishing and hosting platform for AI-generated artifacts, websites, and apps. It lets users publish files or projects to permanent URLs with immutable versions, sharing controls, custom domains, and rollback.
summary: Spacefast exposes two REST API specs on api.spacefast.com (main API and partner API), a hosted OAuth-protected MCP server at mcp.spacefast.com, and the sf CLI; the HTTP API also supports anonymous publish via /v1/publish with a returned Space key.
